intro: Farsen's Watch is an observational task given by Earthseer Farsen, a visiting Wildhammer shaman stationed high above Gol'Bolar Quarry. Using the earthseer's shamanic far sight, adventurers witness firsthand the growing infiltration of Dark Iron dwarves into the heart of Dun Morogh. This crucial survey marks an early step along the path toward the Hall of Thanes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings to ye, friend. My name is Earthseer Farsen and I'm visiting Dun Morogh from Aerie Peak. As I was travelin', I couldn't help but notice that we have, well... A bit o' a Dark Iron Dwarf problem.
If ye have a moment, I can show ye what I mean. I've got a bit o' magic that should do the trick.
